units.source_text: 阳光洒在乡间道路上，弥漫着牛粪的臭气。

en.t: Sunlight poured over the country road, and the stench of cow dung hung in the air.

units.source_text: 他擦着汗，往上坡路走去。

en.t: Wiping away his sweat, he walked up the slope.

units.source_text: 道路两旁散发出成熟小麦的香气。

en.t: From both sides of the road came the fragrance of ripe wheat.
